description: A woman in a winged helmet and chainmail, cape billowing, raises a spear while standing on a rock outcrop with a round patterned shield. Behind her, dark silhouettes of helmeted figures with spears rise out of smoke under a red-orange stormy sky. Wooden stage scaffolding frames both sides, and at the bottom an orchestra pit is lit by candles, with musicians and a conductor in silhouette. No visible text, border or frame; the scene fills the canvas edge to edge.
